reviews.shade: so natural Vegan Make Up Calm Fixer 100ml
reviews.text:
スプレータイプを敏感肌だから使うの躊躇っていて、こちらの肌にも優しそうなスプレーミストタイプのフィクサーからお試し。確かに少し香りは気になりますがあまり香料が強いとそれも肌には良くないのと、天然の原料の匂いで乾いてしまえば残らなく気にならない程度です。
ファンデの種類にもよるかもですがメイクが全然崩れてなかったのでまたリピートします。
reviews.zh:
因為皮膚敏感，所以一直都猶豫緊要唔要用噴霧類型，今次先由呢款睇落對皮膚都溫和嘅霧狀定妝液開始試。確實有少少介意味道，不過香料太濃對皮膚都唔好，加上係天然原料嘅味道，乾咗之後唔會殘留，唔會好介意。
可能要視乎粉底嘅種類，不過我嘅化妝完全冇脫妝，所以會再買。

reviews.shade: so natural Vegan Make Up Calm Fixer 100ml
reviews.text: I personally really like the Hera fixing mist as it's more lightweight and felt very comfortable on my skin. But girl, this thing holds my make up real hard. It stays the same from morning to night. Highly recommend.
reviews.zh: 我個人好鍾意 Hera 定妝噴霧，因為佢更加輕盈，塗落皮膚好舒服。不過姐妹，呢款真係鎖妝鎖得好勁。由朝到晚都係原本嘅樣。極力推薦。

reviews.shade: so natural Vegan Make Up Calm Fixer 100ml
reviews.text: I think it’s very good, holds my makeup in place. It does have fragrance, so if your skin is very sensitive this may not work for you.
reviews.zh: 我覺得好好，可以令化妝固定喺位。佢有香味，所以如果你嘅皮膚好敏感，可能唔啱你。

reviews.shade: so natural Vegan Make Up Calm Fixer 100ml
reviews.text: It’s ok. I got it because the normal version was out of stock, but, it’s a little bit overhyped. Even while wearing it, my makeup does not last long :(
reviews.zh: 一般啦。我買呢款係因為普通版斷貨，但係有啲被過度吹捧咗。即使用緊，我嘅化妝都唔係好耐 :(

reviews.shade: so natural Vegan Make Up Calm Fixer 100ml
reviews.text: I’ve bought the FIXX vegan makeup setting spray multiple times, and it always works amazingly well. It’s definitely a product worth repurchasing!
reviews.zh: 我買過 FIXX vegan 定妝噴霧好多次，效果一直都好驚人。絕對係值得回購嘅產品！

reviews.shade: so natural Vegan Make Up Calm Fixer 100ml
reviews.text: I really like this fixer, I have sensitive skin, it won’t irritate my skin and work really well!!it also can moist ur face a bit. Love this product
reviews.zh: 我好鍾意呢款定妝液，我皮膚敏感，但佢唔會刺激皮膚，效果都好好！！亦都可以令面部稍為濕潤。好鍾意呢款產品。

reviews.shade: so natural Vegan Make Up Calm Fixer 100ml
reviews.text: The normal pink one is out of stock and I can't buy it, so I bought it! is this gas? can? It's not! But the mist is fine here too! I honestly don't know the difference in effects, but the one that has almost no scent is better than pink.
reviews.zh: 普通嘅粉紅色版冇貨，我買唔到，所以買咗呢款！係咪氣體罐？唔係！不過呢款嘅霧都幾好！我老實講唔知道效果有咩分別，但係幾乎冇味嗰款，就好過粉紅色嗰款。

reviews.shade: so natural Vegan Make Up Calm Fixer 100ml
reviews.text: Ingredients may be “clean” but this didn’t do anything to help my makeup last longer. It wasn’t even hydrating enough to my skin under the masks. The scent of this is worse than Urban Decays All Nighter Spray.
reviews.zh: 成分可能係「乾淨」嘅，但係佢對我化妝持久完全冇幫助。喺面膜底下，佢連保濕都唔夠。味道仲比 Urban Decay All Nighter Spray 更差。

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
